decisions.user_review_summary_english: Accepted references: B004-Q01 = within_founder_mosaicism; B004-Q02 = preexisting_albino_allele. Multiple mutant alleles in founder #30 tail DNA show that albinism does not establish one uniform Tyr genotype. The inherited FVB/NJ albino allele prevents offspring phenotype alone from identifying transmission of a newly induced allele. The 23 founders and 57 reported alleles are distinct quantities; allele counts do not establish injected-animal or germline-validated line counts. The validated_new_germline_lines value remains null.
